title: Hexahydrocurcumin from Zingiberis rhizoma attenuates lipopolysaccharide-induced acute pneumonia through JAK1/STAT3 signaling pathway.
authors: Li, Ruopeng; Liang, Qinghe; Yang, Qin; Dai, Wenqi; Xiao, Yao; Pan, Hudan; Zhang, Zhongde; Liu, Liang; Li, Xiaojuan
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究姜黄素衍生物HHC通过抑制JAK1/STAT3信号通路减轻肺炎，仅涉及小分子-蛋白对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Pneumonia is one of the major causes of death after pathogens infection. Zingiberis rhizoma (GAN JIANG) is a herb that used in combination with other Chinese medicines to treat pathogen such as virus induced pneumonia. However, the affect of hexahydrocurcumin (HHC), a component from Zingiberis rhizoma, on pneumonia remains unknown. PURPOSE: This study aims to explore the effects of HHC on lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced acute pneumonia, and to clarify the underlying mechanism. METHODS: The pneumonia model of C57BL/6 mice was established by intratracheal injection of LPS to evaluate the therapeutic effect of HHC on lung injury and inflammation in vivo. RAW264.7 macrophages were utilized to illustrate the cellular mechanism of HHC in vitro. RESULTS: HHC alleviated lung injury, ROS and inflammatory cytokine IL-6 production in pneumonia mice in vivo. Molecular docking results disclosed the binding of HHC to JAK1 protein. The study further showed that HHC suppressed the inflammatory cytokines such as IL-6, TNF-alpha, IL-1beta gene expression, inhibited the phosphorylation of JAK1 but not JAK3, and the subsequent STAT3 phosphorylation in LPS-activated macrophages. HHC exhibited no effects on the protein levels of JAK1 and STAT3 in vitro. Consistently, HHC also attenuated the JAK1, STAT3 phosphorylation in pneumonia mice in vivo. CONCLUSION: The results reveal that HHC attenuates pneumonia by targeted inhibition of JAK1/STAT3 signaling pathway. It indicates the novel role of HHC to treat pneumonia, and its potential applications for JAK inhibitor-treated diseases.
abstract_zh: 背景：肺炎是病原体感染后导致死亡的主要原因之一。干姜（Zingiberis rhizoma）是一种与其他中药联合使用以治疗病毒等病原体所致肺炎的草药。然而，干姜中的成分六氢姜黄素（hexahydrocurcumin, HHC）对肺炎的影响尚不清楚。目的：本研究旨在探讨HHC对脂多糖（lipopolysaccharide, LPS）诱导的急性肺炎的作用，并阐明其潜在机制。方法：通过气管内注射LPS建立C57BL/6小鼠肺炎模型，以评估HHC在体内对肺损伤和炎症的治疗效果。利用RAW264.7巨噬细胞在体外阐明HHC的细胞机制。结果：HHC在体内减轻了肺炎小鼠的肺损伤、活性氧（ROS）和炎症细胞因子IL-6的产生。分子对接结果揭示了HHC与JAK1蛋白的结合。研究进一步表明，HHC抑制了LPS激活的巨噬细胞中IL-6、TNF-α、IL-1β等炎症细胞因子的基因表达，抑制了JAK1（而非JAK3）的磷酸化及随后的STAT3磷酸化。HHC在体外对JAK1和STAT3的蛋白水平无影响。一致地，HHC在体内也减弱了肺炎小鼠中JAK1、STAT3的磷酸化。结论：结果表明，HHC通过靶向抑制JAK1/STAT3信号通路减轻肺炎。这揭示了HHC治疗肺炎的新作用，及其在JAK抑制剂治疗疾病中的潜在应用。
